AnonymousObjectElement.Definition: A value or expression that becomes a named member of an anonymous object.

Argument.Definition: A value passed to a method, constructor, or function when it is invoked.

AssignmentValue.Definition: The value assigned to a variable, field, or property by an assignment or initializer expression.

AttributeArgument.Definition: A value or named parameter passed to an attribute to configure its behavior.

CastTarget.Definition: The value being converted in a cast expression.

CollectionElement.Definition: A value or expression supplied as an element within a collection expression or initializer.

CollectionElementKey.Definition: A value that uniquely identifies an entry in a key-value collection, such as a {c:color-green code}Dictionary{/c}.

CollectionElementValue.Definition: The data stored alongside a key in a key-value collection entry, such as the value half of a {c:color-green code}Dictionary{/c} pair.

CollectionLength.Definition: A value that specifies the number of elements in a newly created collection or span.

IndexValue.Definition: A value that specifies a position or offset used in an index or range when accessing a sequence.

InterpolatedValue.Definition: A value embedded inside an interpolated string that is evaluated and converted to text at runtime.

NullCoalescingAssignmentValue.Definition: The value assigned to the target variable in a null-coalescing assignment ({c:keyword}??={/c}) when the target is {c:color-blue keyword}null{/c}.

QueryReturnValue.Definition: The value or expression in a {c:color-blue keyword}select{/c} clause that determines what each element in the query result will be.

ReturnValue.Definition: A value returned from a method or function as its result.

SwitchArmValue.Definition: The expression produced by a switch expression arm when its pattern matches.

SwitchMatchTarget.Definition: The expression whose value is matched against the patterns of a switch expression.

AddressOfOperand.Definition: The variable or location whose address is obtained by the address-of operator ({c:keyword}&{/c}).

ArithmeticOperand.Definition: A numeric value participating in an arithmetic expression.

BitwiseOperand.Definition: A numeric value participating in a bitwise operation.

ComparisonOperand.Definition: A value being compared in a relational or equality expression.

ConcatenationOperand.Definition: A string or value participating in a string concatenation expression.

DefaultOperand.Definition: The type supplied to the {c:color-blue keyword}default{/c} operator.

DereferenceOperand.Definition: The pointer expression whose referenced value is accessed by the dereference operator ({c:keyword}*{/c}).

LogicalOperand.Definition: A boolean value participating in a logical expression.

NameOfOperand.Definition: The symbol — such as a variable, member, or type — whose name is retrieved as a string by the {c:color-blue keyword}nameof{/c} operator.

NullCoalescingFallback.Definition: The value returned by a null-coalescing expression when the left-hand value is {c:color-blue keyword}null{/c}.

NullCoalescingTarget.Definition: The value evaluated for {c:color-blue keyword}null{/c} in a null-coalescing expression.

NullForgivingOperand.Definition: The expression whose null-state is overridden by the null-forgiving operator ({c:keyword}!{/c}), forcing the compiler to treat it as non-null.

ShiftOperand.Definition: A numeric value participating in a bit shift expression.

SizeOfOperand.Definition: The type supplied to the {c:color-blue keyword}sizeof{/c} operator to determine its compile-time memory size in bytes.

TernaryTrueValue.Definition: The value returned when the value or condition preceding the {c:keyword}?{/c} evaluates to {c:color-blue keyword}true{/c}.

TernaryFalseValue.Definition: The value returned when the ternary condition preceding the {c:keyword}?{/c} evaluates to {c:color-blue keyword}false{/c}.

TypeOfOperand.Definition: The type supplied to the {c:color-blue keyword}typeof{/c} operator to obtain its runtime {c:color-gray keyword}System.Type{/c} representation.

ConstantPattern.Definition: A constant value tested against the input in a pattern matching expression.

PatternBindingVariable.Definition: A variable introduced by a pattern that is assigned the matched value or a component of it when the pattern succeeds.

PatternMatchTarget.Definition: The expression whose runtime value is tested against a pattern in an {c:color-blue keyword}is{/c} expression or switch pattern match.

PropertyPattern.Definition: A property name token within a property pattern that specifies which member of the matched value is evaluated against a nested pattern.

RelationalPattern.Definition: A constant or expression token in a relational pattern that is compared to the matched value using a relational operator ({c:keyword}>{/c}, {c:keyword}<{/c}, {c:keyword}>={/c}, {c:keyword}<={/c}).

TypePattern.Definition: The type being tested against the input in a pattern matching expression.

VarPattern.Definition: The {c:color-blue keyword}var{/c} keyword in a pattern that matches any value and introduces a binding variable for that value or a component of it.

LiteralQualifier.Definition: A literal value used as the object on which a member is accessed, such as calling a method or property directly on a numeric or string literal.

TypeQualifier.Definition: A type qualifier identifies a specific type within a namespace or enclosing type, providing disambiguation when multiple types share the same name.

ArrayBaseType.Definition: The element type of an array declaration, indicating what kind of values the array holds.

CastType.Definition: The target type in a cast expression, specifying what type the value is being converted to.

ConversionTargetType.Definition: The type that a conversion operator converts to, declared as the operator's return type in an {c:color-blue keyword}implicit{/c} or {c:color-blue keyword}explicit{/c} operator declaration.

DeconstructionVariableType.Definition: The data type a variable will have after it has been deconstructed.

DelegateReturnType.Definition: The return type of a delegate declaration, specifying what type of value methods matching this delegate must return.

FieldType.Definition: The declared type of a field, specifying what kind of data the field can store.

Loop Iterator Type.Definition: The data type of the iterator variable declared in a {c:color-purple keyword}for{/c} or {c:color-purple keyword}foreach{/c} loop.

GenericTypeArgument.Definition: A specific type supplied as an argument to a generic type or method, replacing the corresponding type parameter.

LocalFunctionReturnType.Definition: The return type of a local function declaration, specifying what kind of value it produces.

LocalVariableType.Definition: The declared type of a local variable, specifying what kind of value it can hold.

MethodReturnType.Definition: The return type declared in a method signature, specifying what kind of value the method produces.

OperatorReturnType.Definition: The return type of an operator overload declaration, specifying what type the operator produces.

ParameterType.Definition: The declared type of a parameter, specifying what kind of value can be passed for that parameter.

PointerBaseType.Definition: The underlying type in a pointer type declaration, indicating the type of value the pointer can reference.

PropertyType.Definition: The declared type of a property, specifying what kind of value it can get or set.

TupleElement.Definition: A value, type, or named entry at a single position within a tuple expression or type.

TupleElementType.Definition: The declared type of a single element position within a tuple type.

TypeConstraint.Definition: A type that appears in a generic {c:color-blue keyword}where{/c} clause, restricting which types are valid as arguments for the type parameter.

TypeParameterConstraint.Definition: The generic type parameter name in a {c:color-blue keyword}where{/c} clause, identifying which type parameter the constraint applies to.
